name: Female Captain
steps: Drag the mop onto the dirty wooden deck to clean it.
Drag the barbell onto the girl so she can work out and get stronger.
Throw the life buoy to the drowning pirate to rescue him.
Drag the money bundles onto the boat and deck furniture to upgrade them.
Drag the money onto the ship to upgrade its structure.
Drag the money onto the steering wheel to upgrade it.
Drag the sword onto the girl to equip her.
Drag the money to buy a large cannon and place it on the ship.
Drag the telescope onto the ship to install it.
Drag the sailor cap onto the puppy to dress it up.
Drag the money to buy the captain’s outfit and pirate hat for the girl.</li
